themes.consensus_view: Every desk that took a side says demand for AI computing hardware is still running hot, backed by fresh earnings and order numbers, and no bank in this set argued the other way.

facts_agreed.claim: Demand for AI computing hardware remains very strong and is showing up in chip and networking company results.
evidence_quotes: Demand for AI computing remains exceptionally strong
results overnight broadly supportive for AI infrastructure and optical networking

facts_agreed.claim: Companies that own large-scale computing capacity and distribution are seen as the winners of the next stage of AI spending.
evidence_quotes: We remain highly convicted in our view of Alphabet as well positioned

facts_agreed.claim: Several desks track order backlogs and the scale of big cloud providers' spending as the live measures of this theme.
